title: Green Dog and Fractured Eye
description: A surreal desert scene features a large green dog with a human female face on its neck, colorful paint dripping from her eyes and mouth. A black rat sits on the dog's back while a giant cracked red eye with yellow lightning floats in the dark purple sky above a lone silhouetted figure walking in the dunes.
prompt: Surreal desert night scene with a giant lime-green dog in profile, its neck morphing into a woman's face with blue and orange paint dripping down like tears. A black rat sits on the dog's shoulder. In the sky, a massive cracked blood-red eye with yellow energy bolts and black ants crawling on it, a purple moon in the background. A lone silhouetted traveler walks across the sand dunes below, dark purple sky filled with small flying creatures, dramatic and unsettling atmosphere.
